MTR.location: Schirmacher Oasis, Queen Maud Land, East Antarctica
MTR.climate_regime: Inland Antarctic Oasis (Continental rock oasis, moderate katabatic nocturnal wind surges, barometric pressure ~985 hPa, lower relative humidity 40-75%)

BRT.location: Larsemann Hills, Prydz Bay, East Antarctica
BRT.climate_regime: Coastal Promontory (Maritime boundary layer, severe katabatic blizzards up to 55 m/s, barometric pressure ~993 hPa with deep cyclonic troughs down to 930 hPa, higher humidity 60-95%)

public_datasets_investigated.source_authority: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt of India
public_datasets_investigated.dataset_title: Meteorological Observations from Indian Antarctic Stations (Maitri & Bharati)
public_datasets_investigated.usage: Calibrates empirical distributions for wind velocity, barometric pressure cycles, and humidity bounds

public_datasets_investigated.source_authority: Australian Antarctic Data Centre (AADC CC BY 4.0)
public_datasets_investigated.dataset_title: East Antarctic Automatic Weather Station (AWS) Meteorological Archives
public_datasets_investigated.usage: Provides empirical macroscopic benchmark bounds for Antarctic synoptic cyclonic systems and katabatic wind dynamics

provenance_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC_POLARIX_DATA. Generated deterministically from physically grounded Antarctic atmospheric transfer equations, synoptic barometric oscillations, and solar geometry conditioned on NCPOR empirical bounds. Never represented as classified real-time station SCADA telemetry.
